Baldwin County stretches from Mobile Bay's eastern shore to the Gulf beaches of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, and has been among Alabama's fastest-growing counties for three decades. Condominium and resort development drives the coast, while Daphne, Fairhope and Foley add subdivisions, retail and distribution along the I-10 and Highway 59 corridors.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: October 26, 2026
